items.text: Update 1.1.0 is here! Thanks again for all the feedback and support, it continues to help us prioritize what to improve next.
This update introduces a new Split Screen Arcade Co-op mode, allowing two players to take on H.A.N.K. and the TaxiBots together locally.
Alongside that, we’ve added additional vehicle customization options, plus a range of quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: New Game Mode: Split Screen Arcade Co-op

items.text: Introduced a new local Split Screen Arcade Co-op mode where two players can take on H.A.N.K. and the TaxiBots together.
Work together through increasingly difficult arcade challenges, equip abilities after each completed level, and compete for high scores on a brand new co-op leaderboard.
Player 1 takes control of Vinny, while Player 2 joins as Cleo as she finally steps behind the wheel again.
Cash earned in Split Screen Arcade sessions will be added to the primary player’s wallet.
Introduced new wheels for each of the vehicle classes
Added additional traffic signage/destructible objects
Added an option to manually select the game language in the settings menu
Reduced situations where too many markers could appear on screen at once
Non-customer arrow markers, such as those indicating shortcuts, have been given a slightly different colour, to make them easier to differentiate
Resolved issue where the TaxiTank marker would sometimes not correctly appear
Resolved instances where it was possible for the leaderboard entry to not show a name
Resolved issue where certain cranes would be culled while still in view of the player
Resolved issue where the airport building could have noticeable pop-in when switching between LOD quality levels
Resolved issue where toxic fog would no longer affect customer happiness whenever a TaxiBot joined you in the fog
Resolved issue where TaxiBot markers could be shown on locations without TaxiBots
Resolved issue where one of the goal descriptions in the final mission could appear very small
Resolved issue where TaxiBots in the final mission would not spawn tech cores upon destruction
Resolved rare crash that could occur after delivering the landslide chaos resolver
Resolved issue where purchase audio would play when holding down the purchase button over a locked ability
Applying new settings now gives proper input feedback
If you encounter bugs, glitches or have feature requests, the best way to reach out to us is at support@current.games
If you’re enjoying Taxi Chaos 2, consider leaving a review. It really helps us out 🙏

items.text: Update 1.0.3 is here! Thanks again for all the feedback and reports, it continues to help us focus on what matters most.

This patch focuses on audio, with a reworked soundscape to better match the chaotic energy of Taxi Chaos 2. It also adds expanded PC display and graphics settings, alongside quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

We’re back with Update 1.0.2, and first off: thank you. The amount of feedback, reports, and new players jumping into Taxi Chaos 2 has been awesome to see. Keep it coming when you tell us what’s working, what’s not, and where things feel off, it directly helps us prioritize and fix the right stuff.

This update focuses on quality-of-life, stability, and performance, while also adding some new gameplay variety. We’ve been tackling areas where players could get stuck, where progression and Arcade flow needed smoothing, and where the experience needed clearer signposting and more consistency.
Not everything is solved yet but we’re actively working through reports and improving Taxi Chaos 2 step by step.
If you encounter bugs, glitches have feature request the best way to reach out to us is at support@current.games
Added 5 more goal types to add variety to Career and Arcade Mode.
Cash earned in Arcade sessions now counts towards the player’s wallet.

notes.title: We’re happy to share that the first update for Taxi Chaos 2 is here! 🚕💥

items.text: This patch is a quality of life and performance focused update, along with new language additions, built directly from community feedback. We’ve been closely reviewing reports related to crashes, progression issues, Arcade Mode balance, and cases where players could get stuck or blocked. Clear and detailed bug reports genuinely make a difference they help us pinpoint issues faster and resolve them more efficiently. Not all issues have been addressed in this patch, but we are actively working on improving Taxi Chaos 2.

Alongside significant performance optimizations, this update brings improvements to Arcade Mode flow, Story Mode events, TaxiBot behavior, world navigation, and player clarity through better UI signposting. It also lays important groundwork for future updates, further optimization across devices, and new features we’re actively working on.

releases.displayName: Taxi Chaos 2 – January Development Update & Arcade Mode Spotlight

items.text: Hey Taxi Chaos drivers,
We’ve been going through the first big wave of your feedback, and first of all: thank you.
The amount of comments, reviews, feature requests, and bug reports has been incredibly helpful for us as a team.
Right now, we’re actively working on a January patch that focuses on:
Additional language support
Quality of Life improvements
Stability and polish based on early player feedback
This is just the first step. As the weeks progress, we’ll be sharing more updates about new features, requested improvements, and what’s coming next for Taxi Chaos 2.

notes.title: If you haven’t already, please keep sending us

items.text: Feature requests
Bug reports
Balance suggestions
Anything that would make Taxi Chaos 2 more fun for you
We read everything.

We’re a small team from the Netherlands, and while we don’t have infinite budgets or manpower, we care deeply about this game and this community. That means we’ll keep prioritizing what matters most to players to make Taxi Chaos 2 the most enjoyable experience possible. We really appreciate your patience while we patch, polish, and improve everything step by step.
Arcade Mode Spotlight!
While we’re working on patches and improvements, don’t forget to check out Arcade Mode.
In Arcade Mode, you jump into a single high-score run where the challenges become progressively more intense.
Earn and stack cash points, push your limits, and compete for your place on the global leaderboards.
If you haven’t tried it yet, make sure to check out our Arcade Mode showcase video below.
More updates coming (very) soon, and as always, we’ll keep listening.
